//RateLimiting: security-hardening-pre-pilot D7. Deliberately NOT configured here: the built-in defaults in RateLimiting.cs apply when the keys are absent, and pinning them in appsettings.json would shadow the per-test overrides (which arrive via host settings, a lower-priority source than appsettings). To disable in an environment, set RateLimiting__Enabled=false; to retune, set RateLimiting__Ingest__TokenLimit etc.
